# WALDOR Clinic

> WALDOR Clinic is a luxury skin, hair and longevity clinic in London, offering bespoke aesthetic treatments backed by AI-led skin analysis and expert practitioners.

WALDOR Clinic is located at 35 Great Portland Street, London W1W 8QQ, open Monday to Saturday, 10:00-18:00. Every treatment begins with a personalised consultation, and select treatments are enhanced with a complimentary 4D AI Skin Analysis. The clinic specialises in facials, injectables, body contouring, hair restoration and longevity-focused skincare.

## Treatments

- [HydraGlass Facial Treatments](https://waldorclinic.com/treatments/hydra-glass): Korean-inspired glass-skin facials, from classic HydraGlass to Premium, Longevity, Lymphatic Sculpt and Lifting variants.
- [Signature Treatments](https://waldorclinic.com/treatments/waldor-signature): Curated combination treatments including South Korean Glass Skin, XERF Structural Tightening, CO2 Laser and chemical peels.
- [Body Contouring Treatments](https://waldorclinic.com/treatments/body-treatment): Bespoke body packages for cellulite, post-pregnancy recovery, weight loss and contouring.
- [Injectable Treatments](https://waldorclinic.com/treatments/injectables): Prescription-only injectables, discussed and administered following a medical consultation.
- [Hair Growth Treatments](https://waldorclinic.com/treatments/hair-growth): Scientific hair restoration beginning with an AI Scalp & Hair Analysis.

## What makes WALDOR distinct

- Every treatment starts with a personalised consultation, never a generic package.
- Select treatments include a complimentary 4D AI Skin Analysis from Japan.
- A longevity-first philosophy: treatments are chosen for long-term skin and hair health, not just short-term results.
